name: ai-optimize-master
description: AI 优化大师 — audit duplicate, broken and stale AI-tool skills, propose improvements, archive reversibly.

interface.shortDescription: Audit duplicate, broken and stale AI-tool skills; propose improvements; clean up reversibly.
interface.longDescription: Scans the skill roots of every AI tool on this machine, reports byte-identical duplicates, diverged copies, dangling local references and unreadable roots, surfaces MCP declarations without executing any server, and proposes improvements as diffs. Cleanup is opt-in per skill: a hash-bound plan, a journal, and byte-exact undo.
defaultPrompt: 扫描我的 AI 工具技能目录，告诉我哪些重复、断链、该升级。
